name: GlossyOrbs
description: An invented analytics platform whose whole illustration language is glossy gradient spheres
intent: One illustration language and nothing else: every picture on the page is a radial-gradient sphere with a highlight, so a page that would normally be carried by stock photography is carried by six CSS gradients instead.
